leads.claim: The USG has never captured or exploited UAP-derived materials.
leads.why: The document explicitly addresses the existence of UAP-derived materials and denies their capture or exploitation by any USG or private entity.
leads.government_response: AARO states no evidence exists for such capture or exploitation.
leads.quote: To date, no evidence suggests that a USG or private entity has ever captured or exploited UAP-derived materials.

doc_verdict: The document explicitly denies the existence of any captured or exploited UAP-derived materials in the possession of the USG or private entities.
